entities.name: Josef Antonín Hůlka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Josef Antonín Hůlka was a Czech Roman Catholic clergyman. He was ordained priest on 18 July 1875 in České Budějovice, later becoming one of its canons. He was nominated its bishop on 4 December 1907 by Francis Joseph I of Austria, a nomination confirmed by Pope Pius X twelve days later. He was consecrated bishop on 6 January 1908.

entities.summary: Josef Antonín Hůlka was a Czech Roman Catholic clergyman. He was ordained priest on 18 July 1875 in České Budějovice, later becoming one of its canons. He was nominated its bishop on 4 December 1907 by Francis Joseph I of Austria, a nomination confirmed by Pope Pius X twelve days later. He was consecrated bishop on 6 January 1908.
